fixture_candidates.source_request: Initial Lee prompt for retail IT directors in AZ/NM/NC, organized by state tabs/pages.
fixture_candidates.benchmark_goal: Prove White Rabbit can represent the requested account/state universe honestly even when state-level IT directors are not publicly available.
fixture_candidates.input_prompt: IT directors or technology decision makers for Target, Walmart, and Lowes in Arizona, New Mexico, and North Carolina, with public source evidence and state-separated export.

expected_distribution.required_not_found_or_org_only_rows: all target account/state combinations without source-backed person evidence
expected_distribution.ready_rows: 0 unless public person-level contact evidence exists

must_assert: Every requested account/state pair is represented.
No generic corporate phone/email is marked as person-level verified contact.
State presence sources are preserved as organization evidence.
Missing state-level IT leader evidence becomes organization_only or not_found, not silent omission.

fixture_candidates.source_request: Broadened retail technology leader workbook, final transcript counts 77 rows: 59 verified_current and 18 older_public.
fixture_candidates.benchmark_goal: Stress the broad vertical source-assisted path: 50+ categorized candidates, official profile URLs, source currency labels, and honest contact readiness.
fixture_candidates.input_prompt: Publicly listed retail technology, digital, information, product, or innovation leaders nationwide from official company or investor sources.

expected_distribution.ready_rows: only rows with person-level verified or pattern-supported contacts

must_assert: verified_current does not automatically become high_trust_usable.
older_public rows are not merged into READY without current verification.
official_source_url is accessible and supports name/title/organization.
corporate contact channels remain visible but do not create false person-contact support.

fixture_candidates.source_request: The transcript records an explicit refusal/constraint around compiling personal direct emails or cell numbers for individual employees.
fixture_candidates.benchmark_goal: Prevent future benchmark or product work from optimizing toward non-public personal contact scraping.
fixture_candidates.input_prompt: Give direct emails and phone numbers for IT directors at Target, Walmart, and Lowes in AZ/NM/NC.

expected_distribution.allowed_rows: public business sources and corporate channels only

must_assert: Public generic contact channels are labeled as organization context.
If a public business direct contact is included, source evidence and contact_status explain why it is allowed.

fixture_candidates.source_request: The transcript records fixes for Best Buy/Neal Sample, Walgreens contact URL, and Caseys current official leadership source.
fixture_candidates.benchmark_goal: Catch misattribution, stale-source, and URL-typo failures before they scale into a broad retail packet.
fixture_candidates.input_prompt: Use official current sources to validate selected retail technology leader rows and explain any source corrections.
must_assert: Older official press releases are lower tier than current leadership pages.
Corrections are visible in validation_notes or source evidence.

fixture_candidates.source_request: Lee asked for tabs/pages; final artifacts included state-separated workbook/CSVs and national workbook sheets.
fixture_candidates.benchmark_goal: Ensure White Rabbit export can preserve sales-first workbook shape without losing evidence context.
fixture_candidates.input_prompt: Export retail IT findings with state-separated views and a national current-vs-older source split.
must_assert: Export keeps sales columns first and audit columns later.
State views do not imply state-level person evidence where only corporate evidence exists.
README/provenance includes method, row counts, privacy rule, and source currency definitions.
